summary: Iteration 7 focused on the new 'entries always land on today' behaviour. Backend regression: full existing pytest suite (backend_test.py, test_preset_names.py, test_deficit.py) = 44/44 passed, including POST /api/meals with explicit date, POST /api/presets/{id}/log, nutrition/estimate, meals CRUD, settings, activity, summary/monthly, deficit/monthly, export. Frontend E2E on the public URL verified: (1) focusing meal-description-input while browsing Aug 22 snaps selected-date back to 'Today'; (2) window 'focus' event snaps back to today; (3) 'visibilitychange' event snaps back to today; (4) preset one-tap log while browsing yesterday wrote the meal to today's Lunch (verified via GET /api/meals for both dates: today gained the row, Aug 22 unchanged) and selected-date snapped to Today; (5) full save flow (navigate back a day, type, navigate back again, Calculate nutrition -> real GPT estimate -> Save) persisted the meal to today's Breakfast, meal-count went 5 -> 6 meals today with Aug 22 untouched, and selected-date snapped to Today; (6) regressions preset rename via PATCH and CSV export dialog href (/api/export/meals.csv?start=..&end=..) both work. All test-created preset/meals were deleted in teardown; dashboard restored to its original 4 meals today / 3 on Aug 22. No console errors, no error elements rendered.

issues: Large empty dark-green area below the entry box on 1920px desktop; entry column height is not balanced with the hero image (pre-existing).
From/To fields use the native browser date input picker instead of a styled calendar component (pre-existing).

action_items: Minor UX: jumpToToday() changes dateKey, and the useEffect on dateKey calls setEstimate(null). If a user browsing a past date already produced a GPT estimate and then clicks back into the textarea, the (up to 120s) estimate is silently discarded. Consider preserving the pending estimate when the date snap is triggered by focus.
Minor UX: when a save/preset-log silently relocates the entry from the browsed past date to today, there is no toast/notice explaining the jump. A short inline message would avoid confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: The focus/visibilitychange listener effect depends on [date] and re-registers on every date change; harmless but it could read date from a ref or use a functional setDate to keep a single stable listener.
visibilitychange handler does not check document.visibilityState, so it also fires when the tab becomes hidden. Behaviourally fine here (it only snaps the date forward) but semantically loose.
There is no timer-based rollover: if the tab stays focused across midnight, the selected date stays on the previous day until the next focus/visibility event. Acceptable for now, worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created preset 'TEST_iter7_preset' plus two test meals (preset log + GPT-saved meal); all deleted in teardown via /app/backend/tests/seed_preset_iter7.py cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Date-snap feature fully verified (focus, window focus, visibilitychange, save flow, preset log). Backend untouched and 44/44 tests pass. Use /app/backend/tests/seed_preset_iter7.py {seed|counts|cleanup} to seed a preset and inspect/clean today's + yesterday's meals. GPT estimate for a short meal returned in well under 150s. Remaining open items are only the two minor UX suggestions listed in action_items.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found in the tested behaviour.
